superseded_artifacts.reason: image bytes were correct but the OCI revision label did not equal the exact Git commit; no Machine received this artifact

audit_scope: attempt, lease, heartbeat and progress deadlines
scheduler cadence, capacity and durable dependency ordering
SIGTERM, terminal grace and platform stop contracts
circuit retry identity, timing and episode budgets
fan-in terminal eligibility and lost-wakeup repair
qualification release, breaker and operator continuity

root_causes.finding: A failed Structure source attempt reused the same long-lived Gamma HTTP transport generation.
root_causes.repair: Reset only the failed transport generation while retaining the service-owned rate limiter.

root_causes.finding: Five asynchronous workers called synchronous claim_job on the coordinator event loop, delaying unrelated timers and cancellation.
root_causes.repair: All asynchronous claim sites use the shared cancellable daemon blocking bridge; database policy remains the only claim I/O deadline.

root_causes.finding: A new failure fingerprint inherited an exhausted recovery budget from an older defect on the same target.
root_causes.repair: Revision 035 keys recovery budgets by immutable failure episode while retaining legacy exhaustion history.

root_causes.finding: A timeout before the first completed provider step collapsed to a generic started state.
root_causes.repair: Persist stage-start facts before fetch, validation, upload and commit; terminal receipt remains the only completion authority.

root_causes.finding: The advertised 12-lane Quote role executed 148 batches serially and contradicted the 900-second freshness gate.
root_causes.repair: Independent fenced lanes derive concurrency from the existing CLOB resource authority and contain one lane failure locally.

root_causes.finding: Concurrent final producers could each miss the sibling's uncommitted receipt and permanently leave a complete certifier waiting.
root_causes.repair: Terminal transition precedes a serialized successor-row check that requires receipt plus succeeded producer; claim-time repair handles historical gaps.

root_causes.finding: Successful actions and terminal jobs could coexist with open reconciler recovery incidents; later episodes could remain falsely resolved.
root_causes.repair: Lease-fenced target recovery closes all bounded incident forms, and new episodes explicitly reopen their current projection.

root_causes.finding: The Structure source pool hid its lanes' common lease, so SIGTERM grace resolution raised ValueError and exited the coordinator with code 1.
root_causes.repair: The pool validates and exposes one positive common lease; central runtime policy remains the only grace authority.

root_causes.finding: A long sequence of individually sub-heartbeat R2 calls never entered the timeout polling branch and silently expired its cumulative lease.
root_causes.repair: Both synchronous bridges check heartbeat_if_due after every successful nonterminal call boundary as well as during a slow call.

root_causes.finding: An authorized long-running circuit probe outlived its short claim window; a trusted deployment interruption made the job retryable behind the already-expired open circuit, requiring another action from the same recovery episode.
root_causes.repair: The fenced interruption transaction renews the existing policy-derived claim window while preserving open state, failure identity/count and episode budget.

root_causes.finding: Real-PostgreSQL concurrency barriers used unrelated five-second, ten-second and unbounded waits, allowing host load to create a false failure or a missing peer to hang validation forever.
root_causes.repair: All six barriers now use one diagnostic watchdog derived from the named control-plane database stop envelope; durable results, not wall time, remain the assertions.

local_verification.retry_policy_authority_contract: lookup/backoff parity passed without fixed consumer count
local_verification.exact_release_full_m1_suite: running 4059 tests without an outer timeout

operator_incident.finding: A read-only SSH qualification-status launched a second Python interpreter on the 256 MiB qualification Machine and OOM-killed the resident daemon.
operator_incident.repair: Do not run diagnostic interpreters inside 256 MiB resident Machines; use the independent API, bounded direct reads or isolated disposable Machines.
operator_incident.continuity_effect: The affected qualification epoch is invalid and cannot be reused.

rollout.qualification_state: recovering while historical facts and the new Structure pipeline converge

completion_boundary: M1 is not complete until this exact release earns a fresh continuous 86400-second qualification certificate and that immutable certificate is independently reverified.
